remarks: Welcome to 82 Rippowam Road, a charming and spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bath home located just steps from the beach in Stamford's sought-after Shippan neighborhood. This well-maintained residence offers over 2,500 sq ft of living space, featuring bright, open rooms and a versatile layout perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy stunning views of Long Island Sound and Fourth of July fireworks from the top deck, creating unforgettable summer memories. With its unbeatable location near parks, marinas, restaurants, and just minutes from downtown and the train station, this home combines coastal living with commuter convenience
